hana (Docs): Quick thread for the next release notes draft: PR https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/523. Scope: routing telemetry blurb, a short "known issue" entry about canary latency, updated Python streaming sample, and a migration note for SDK users. Need sign-off and i18n keys.

evan (PM): Thanks. Minimal checklist: 1) one-line changelog bullet, 2) expanded release-note paragraph, 3) known-issue with repro + runbook link, 4) snippet + compatibility advice, 5) i18n keys, 6) privacy-friendly telemetry copy.

mira (Eng): Repro (concise): deploy canary @ 10% traffic, run 220 QPS with 95th token lengths ~480 for 180s, observe canary p95 ~30-45% higher due to KV cache churn + routing oscillation. Mitigation: route pin to dedicated or run prefix warmup. I'll create a one-screen runbook link: docs/runbooks/canary-latency.md

hana (Docs): Perfect — I need that runbook URL for the known-issue note. Also: legal/priv text requested.

ralph (DevEx): Snippet change: new SDK streaming API returns an iterator; old API used stream=True on create(). Proposed new example (SDK >=2.1.0):

```python
resp = client.chat.stream(model="kestrel-v1", input=prompt)
for chunk in resp:
    sys.stdout.write(chunk.delta)
```

And legacy fallback for <=2.0.x: 
```python
# legacy
res = client.chat.create(model="kestrel-v1", input=prompt, stream=True)
for chunk in res:
    print(chunk)
```
Add a compatibility note: "If you cannot upgrade to SDK >=2.1.0, use the legacy streaming API; chunk shapes differ."

sofia (L10N): Please extract these exact user strings and file paths so we can queue translations today: 
- "Adaptive routing telemetry enabled — learn more"
- "Known: canary latency may be elevated under burst; see mitigation"
- "Requires SDK >= 2.1.0 for the new streaming API"
Paths: docs/content/release-notes/0.9.x/*.md and docs/src/snippets/python/streaming.md. Add to tracker: https://l10n.internal/tasks/1815

privacy-bot: Telemetry copy recommendation: "We collect aggregated routing telemetry (latency and error rates) to improve service reliability. We do not store user text payloads as part of this telemetry." Keep it high level.

hana (Docs): OK I'll add the privacy line as a footnote in the telemetry paragraph and paste runbook link. Draft one-line changelog: "Improve routing with adaptive telemetry and a canary rollout — see known issue for mitigation." Longer paragraph will expand on telemetry and link to the runbook.

evan (PM): Do we need a short note for customers using Dedicated/Draft? Maybe a small admin instruction: "If you observe degraded canary latency, bind traffic to dedicated via routing policy."

mira (Eng): Good idea; add a small admin troubleshooting step (one-liner) and link to the UI docs for routing policies.

hana (Docs): Thanks — I'll update the PR with runbook and legal text, export i18n keys, and request final thumbs. Planning to merge tomorrow 09:00 PT after confirmations. Please react with :thumbsup: when you approve.
